landing.heroTitle: The World Cup 2026 pool, played with your friends
landing.heroDesc: Predict the scores, earn badges like <1>"The Ace"</1> or <2>"The Jinx"</2>, and share your player card with the group. Free, simple, and with the right amount of trash talk.
landing.step1Text: Set up a group with your friends in seconds, or join with a 6-character code or an invite link from someone in the group.
landing.step2Title: Submit your prediction before each match starts
landing.step2Text: Pick the exact score with an animated picker — tap, swipe, or scroll with your mouse, whichever works best. Once the match starts, your prediction is locked in.
landing.step3Title: Score points based on how well you called it
landing.step3Text: 3 points for an exact result, 1 point for getting the winner or draw right, and 0 if you missed. The table updates live while matches are played.
landing.step4Title: Get your matchday badge and share it
landing.step4Text: Each matchday, Prodea assigns you a character based on how you played: "The Ace" if you were the best, "The Jinx" if you were the worst, "The Sleeper" if you forgot to submit... and many more. A trading card with your badge is generated automatically, ready to send to the group chat.
landing.feat1Title: More than a pool: an excuse to roast the group
landing.feat1Text: Unlike spreadsheets or makeshift groups, Prodea puts a name, face, and humor on every matchday. It's not just about who's first in the table — it's about who was "The Clown" that didn't get a single result, or who earned the title of "The Oracle" for being clairvoyant.
landing.feat2Text: Predictions lock as soon as the match starts, so nobody can "adjust" their forecast after seeing the early result. Fair for everyone, and doesn't depend on the admin being on top of it.
landing.feat3Title: Results and table in real time
landing.feat3Text: While matches are being played, Prodea fetches results automatically and updates the standings instantly — no page reloads, no waiting for someone to enter the result manually (though the tournament admin can always correct it if needed).
landing.feat4Title: Cards to share, made to go viral
landing.feat4Text: At the end of each matchday, every player gets a trading card with their badge, phrase, and ranking — designed to be sent straight to Instagram or WhatsApp.
landing.howItLooks: This is how Prodea is played
landing.screen1Alt: Screen to submit your prediction with an animated goal picker
landing.screen1Caption: Submit your prediction with an animated picker
landing.screen1Text: pick the score with spinning wheels — tap, swipe, or scroll with the mouse.
landing.screen2Alt: Tournament leaderboard updating in real time
landing.screen2Text: while the match is being played, you can see your position move in real time.
landing.screen3Alt: Trading card with a player's matchday badge
landing.screen3Caption: Get your badge and share it
landing.screen3Text: a new card awaits you each matchday. Will you be "The Ace" or "The Jinx" this time?
landing.faq1a: Yes, totally free. You can create or join tournaments with up to 100 participants at no cost.
landing.faq2q: How do I join my friends' tournament?
landing.faq2a: Ask the tournament admin for the 6-character code or invite link, and you'll join straight from the app.
landing.faq3q: What happens if I don't submit my prediction in time?
landing.faq3a: Predictions close automatically when the match starts. If you didn't submit yours, you get 0 points that matchday — and you'll probably get the "Sleeper" badge 😴.
landing.faq4a: 3 points for guessing the exact score, 1 point for getting the winner or draw right (without the exact score), and 0 if you got nothing right.
landing.faq5q: Can I play from my phone?
landing.faq5a: Yes, Prodea is a PWA — you can install it directly from your browser to your home screen, like a native app, without going through any app store.
landing.faq6a: They're characters the app assigns to each player every matchday, based on how they did: "The Ace" for the top score, "The Jinx" for the worst, "The Sniper" for nailing an exact score, and many more. Each one comes with its own card to share.
